chars.HUSBAND: THE HUSBAND: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, neat short beard, wearing a light blue office shirt with rolled-up sleeves and dark grey trousers
chars.WIFE: THE WIFE: a Moroccan woman around 28, oval face, dark eyebrows, wearing a fluffy white bathrobe and a bright pink towel wrapped around her hair like a turban

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the open bedroom doorway: THE WIFE, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible with a nervous guilty look over her shoulder, hurriedly sliding a stack of official stamped papers under the pillow of the bed. Modest Moroccan apartment bedroom, zellige-patterned bedspread, morning light. Main action in the centre of the frame, calm edges. No text, no writing on the papers.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND has just come home early, standing by the bed in a Moroccan bedroom, staring curiously at a pile of official papers lying on the bedspread; behind him the bathroom door is half open with steam coming out and the sound of the shower implied. Head-to-knee framing, face visible, puzzled expression. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of THE HUSBAND sitting on the edge of the bed holding an official property contract with a small floor-plan drawing of an apartment on it, eyes wide in shock, mouth open. Moroccan bedroom background softly blurred. No readable text, only abstract lines on the paper.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND sitting on the bed, frowning suspiciously, rubbing his beard, the papers on his knees, glancing toward the steamy bathroom door. Moody side light, Moroccan bedroom. Face visible. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND secretly photographing the papers spread on the bed with his smartphone, crouched, looking nervously toward the bathroom door which is starting to open with steam. Moroccan bedroom. Face visible. No text on phone or papers.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: THE WIFE just out of the shower, standing by the bed, quickly gathering the papers into her arms and hiding them behind her back with a forced innocent smile; THE HUSBAND lies on the bed pretending to rest, one eye open watching her. Moroccan bedroom. Both faces visible. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND lying awake on the bed staring at the photo of the contract on his phone, shocked and hurt; through the window behind him a brand-new modern Moroccan apartment building under construction cranes in another city skyline. Face visible. No text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: THE WIFE at the dressing table slipping a folder of papers into her handbag and zipping it shut, glancing in the mirror; in the mirror reflection THE HUSBAND stands in the doorway with crossed arms, staring at her with a questioning, betrayed look. Moroccan bedroom. Both faces visible. No text.
